message:
You know that feeling when you finally get to be the one who’s prepared? 🌟 Last week, we had a surprise storm warning, and instead of scrambling like we usually do, we felt a sense of calm. We had our go-bags ready, water stocked, and even the important documents were in one place. It was a relief to know we weren’t caught off guard this time! 

It reminded us how valuable it is to take those small steps towards readiness. What’s a tip or trick you have that helps you feel more prepared?
